No DOM / lucide-react / Recharts / Leaflet / old web-UI imports — only RN primitives (View/Animated/StyleSheet/AccessibilityInfo/Easing) plus the native AppText and the native SemanticIcon glyph helper. Behaviour / state names / API paths (none) / i18n keys preserved.

Unit handling: the temperature values are SI Celsius and converted only at the display boundary (formatTemperatureUnit, '°C' SI-floor, precision 1, no space before °unit), matching the web useUnits()/unitConversion contract; the '% of max' ratio and 'kW' peak-power value are unit-agnostic and reproduced verbatim. No new unit-suffixed fields are introduced.

RN-unavailable / approximated web behaviours documented: lucide Heart/Zap -> SemanticIcon glyph chips tinted to the card colour; the responsive sm:3 / lg:6 grid collapses to the mobile-first 2-column base; arbitrary forwarded sensor.icon nodes are rendered as-is (native cannot re-tint an opaque child View, same as the web when the child sets its own colour); hover border-colour transition on the card (web `hover:border-white/[0.08]`) has no RN equivalent and is dropped (the rest-state border is retained).
Gates run from apps/native: npm run typecheck; npm run lint -- --quiet; npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles.
